scenario.name: lora-plan-test-a40
scenario.description: Task 8.3 (D42) test run on one Runpod A40: the adapter chosen on dev (all-r4 from lora-plan-a40-b: all 2,660 synthetic pairs, rank 4, compact prompt) and the base control it is compared against (Qwen3.5-4B with the service's full prompt, E-069's configuration), each recording the frozen test split once on the same server as the dev ablation (BF16, greedy, structured outputs on, thinking off, no prefix caching). No load test: latency under load is 8.4 and 8.5. Scored on the laptop by the replayed eval (make eval-replay SPLIT=test).

notes: Closed-loop load on the planner's real first-attempt prompts (dev questions), warmup excluded; times are measured on the pod (client and server on one host). valid_rate = first-attempt replies that parse and pass the planner's validation. Recorded replies feed `python -m vms.eval run --planner replay` (D40).; GPU session 01M5NB4JNRN6P3478CK6B086PG (Runpod A40, SECURE); git from the session
